tex: N = \frac{HW}{P^2}, \quad \mathbf{z}_0 = [\mathbf{x}_{\text{class}}; \, \mathbf{x}_p^1 E; \, \mathbf{x}_p^2 E; \dots; \, \mathbf{x}_p^N E] + E_{\text{pos}}, \quad E \in \mathbb{R}^{(P^2 C) \times D}

tex: \text{IG}(S, A) = H(S) - \sum_{v \in \text{Val}(A)} \frac{|S_v|}{|S|} H(S_v), \quad \text{GainRatio}(S, A) = \frac{\text{IG}(S, A)}{\text{SplitInfo}(S, A)}
